description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data sources in the combined training set. The chart is divided into 12 slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled with their corresponding data source names and percentage values, and are colored differently, although the exact shades are not distinguishable. The largest slice, representing 31.3%, is labeled as "SCIFACT" and is colored blue, while the other slices range in size from 0.1% to 16.1%. The slices are arranged in a seemingly random order, with no apparent pattern or ranking. The chart includes labels for each slice, with percentage values displayed next to or outside the chart, and some slices are connected to their labels with leader lines. No legend is present, but the labels provide sufficient information to identify each slice.
